name: stronghold
description: Follow eyes of ender to a stronghold, find the portal room, fill the frame, enter the End.
goal: You are near a stronghold with eyes of ender, a diamond pickaxe, armour and food. The standard library already has this whole route, so use it instead of writing your own digger: start a snippet with `use "lib/ender"`, then (1) `follow_eyes()` if you still need to find the stronghold - skip it if an eye already drops straight down where you stand; (2) `dive_for_portal()` repeatedly - it sinks a bounded distance with `dig_down` and scans 64 blocks for the portal frames every few blocks, and returns `.found`, `.sunk` and `.stopped`; (3) `fill_portal()` to put an eye in every empty frame; (4) `enter_end()` to step onto the portal. Keep every call short and read the result between calls rather than running one long script. Do NOT cut a staircase down - `dig_down` is implemented, safe, and about four times faster. Say 'in the end' once you are there.
